content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We are seeking an experienced Claude AI developer to build custom AI skills and intelligent workflows for a Florida-based family law firm. The goal is to streamline legal operations, reduce repetitive administrative work, and improve efficiency while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and attorney oversight.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop custom Claude AI skills tailored to Florida family law workflows.

Automate legal document drafting, case summaries, client intake, and document analysis.

Create reusable prompts, templates, and structured workflows for common family law matters.

Ensure workflows follow firm-specific procedures and relevant Florida legal requirements.

Implement appropriate privacy safeguards, validation steps, and attorney review checkpoints.

Document the workflows and provide guidance for practical day-to-day use.

Ideal Candidate:
Experience with Claude AI, prompt engineering, AI workflow automation, and legal document processing. Familiarity with Florida family law, legal technology, and confidential client information is highly desirable.

The ideal solution should be reliable, easy for legal professionals to use, and designed to support—not replace—attorney judgment.
</untrusted_participant_content>
